agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 28, 2020 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the October 14, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-10-28 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Analyst McShane
Approve the Warrants.
2020-10-28 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Youth Commission Work Plan Outcomes for Fiscal Year 2019-2020 and Proposed Work Plan for Fiscal Year 2020-2021. Contact Person: Recreation Supervisor II Hernandez
1) Receive final report outcomes for the Fiscal Year 2019-2020 Youth Commission Work Plan; and 2) Approve the proposed Fiscal Year 2020-2021 Youth Commission Work Plan
2020-10-28 Item 08C Youth Commisson FY 2019-20 Work Plan Outcomes
8D.
To Initiate solicitation of a Request for Proposals for consultant services to update the Circulation Element of the General Plan. Contact Person: Planner IV Plagemann
Direct staff to release the Request for Proposals (RFP) for the Circulation Element Update.
2020-10-28 Item 08D RFP for Circulation Element
8E.
Contract award for Encinitas Community Center Art Lighting System. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
1) Award Bid for the Encinitas Community Center Art Lighting System to Scansys, INC. DBA Scansys Construction; 2) Authorize the City Manager in consultation with the City Attorney to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in the amount of $19,575 and a 10 percent (10%) contingency of $1,958 for the project in the event that additional work is needed, for a total contract not to exceed $21,533; and 3) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-84, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget” in attachment 2 of the agenda report to allocate $1,533 to the Encinitas Community Center Art Lighting System Project (CIP) CF18B.
2020-10-28 Item 08E Contract Award for Encinitas Community Center Art Lighting System
8F.
Construction Contract Award for the Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project Phase 1 (CC04J). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
1) Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with CCL Contracting Inc., in the amount of $2,626,124 plus 15 percent contingency ($393,919), for a total construction contract not-to-exceed amount of $3,020,043; and 2) Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 2 of the agenda report and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Dudek, for construction support on the Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project Phase 1 project in the amount of $293,776 plus 10 percent contingency ($29,378) for a total not-to-exceed amount of $323,154.
2020-10-28 Item 08F Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Phase I CC04J
8G.
Extensions of the Memorandum of Agreement with the County of San Diego Health and Human Services Agency and the Memorandum of Understanding with the Community Resource Center for the Temporary Emergency Motel Voucher Program for the COVID-19 response for emergency non-congregate sheltering to December 30, 2020. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Authorize the City Manager to execute, in substantial form, as attached, in consultation with the City Attorney, an amendment to the Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between the City of Encinitas and the County of San Diego to provide up to 22 hotel rooms for “high-risk” individuals that are experiencing homelessness during the COVID-19 pandemic to extend and render payment from November 1, 2020 up to December 30, 2020; and 2) Subject to the approval of the above-refenced County MOA, authorize the City Manager to execute, in substantial form, as attached, in consultation with the City Attorney the amendment to the existing Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Community Resource Center (CRC) to provide case management services for the current “high-risk” individuals utilizing temporary lodging at a cost not-to-exceed $3,200 ($50 per room per week) for an extended period from October 31, 2020 to December 30, 2020. The MOU and subsequent amendment, if approved, would not apply to those individuals participating in the Opening Doors or Homeless Prevention and Intervention Fund Programs, which is currently seven of the 14 remaining households.
2020-10-28 Item 08G Temporary Emergency Motel Voucher Extension
8H.
Appointment to the Traffic and Public Safety Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy for the Olivenhain representative. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Mayor’s recommendation to appoint David Perryman to the Traffic and Public Safety Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy for the Olivenhain representative with a term ending March 2021.
2020-10-28 Item 08H Appointment to TPS Commission Unscheduled Vacancy - REDACTED
8I.
Acceptance of the B Street Sidewalk Improvements Project (CS18G). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Adopt Resolution No. 2020-68 accepting the public improvements for the B Street Sidewalk Improvements Project (CS18G) as complete to the satisfaction of the City; authorizing the filing of the Notice of Completion for the Project; authorizing the release of the payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; and authorizing the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion.
2020-10-28 Item 08I NOC B Street Sidewalks
8J.
Second reading of Ordinance 2020-17 establishing informal bidding procedures under the Uniform Public Construction Cost Accounting Act. Contact Person: Associate Traffic Engineer Goralka
Adopt Ordinance 2020-17, entitled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Adding Chapter 7.20 to the Encinitas Municipal Code Establishing Informal Bidding Procedures Under the Uniform Public Construction Cost Accounting Act.”
2020-10-28 Item 08J Uniform Cost Accounting Ordinance Adoption
8K.
Construction contract Award for the 1691 & 1711 Eolus Avenue Storm Drain Improvements Project (CD05E). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with DB Pipeline Inc., in the amount of $89,300 plus 15 percent contingency ($13,395), for a total construction contract not-to-exceed amount of $102,695 for the 1691 & 1711 Eolus Avenue Storm Drain Improvements Project (CD05E).
2020-10-28 Item 08K 1691 & 1711 Eolus Avenue Storm Drain Improvements
8L.
Award the Coast Highway 101 Traffic Signal Painting Contract. Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Edgeworth
1) Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Streetlight Restoration Specialists, Inc. in the amount of $129,420 plus 10 percent contingency ($12,942) to complete the Coast Highway 101 Traffic Signal Painting Project, for a total construction contract not-to-exceed amount of $142,362; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-86, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report) to allocate $45,947 to the Coast Highway 101 Traffic Signal Painting Project.
2020-10-28 Item 08L Coast Hwy 101 Traffic Signal Painting Contract
8M.
FY 2020-2021 Annual Citywide Pavement Resurfacing, Slurry and Overlay Project (CS21A). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
Approve the FY 20-21 List of Roads for Slurry and Asphalt Overlay (Attachment 1) and associated Construction Specifications (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2020-10-28 Item 08M FY 2020-21 Annual Citywide Pavement Rehab
8N.
FY 2019-20 Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report (CAPER) for the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
1) Approve the FY 2019-20 CAPER (Attachment 2 of the agenda report); and 2) Authorize the City Manager or designee to submit the FY 2019-20 CAPER to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD).
2020-10-28 Item 08N Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report (CAPER)
8O.
Additional work for City Hall Improvements Phase I. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
1) Authorize additional funding for the City Hall Improvements Phase 1 Project (CF20C) in the amount of $60,000 to be transferred from the Public Works Facility Improvement Project (CF16D);
2)Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a change order with Firestone Builders, Inc. for an additional amount not to exceed $50,000 to bring the total contract amount to $807,911; and 3) Adopt Resolution 2020-99 Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget.
2020-10-28 Item 08O City Hall Renovations Amendment 1
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Continued public hearing to consider a timely-filed appeal of the Planning Commission’s approval of the consolidation of two underlying legal parcels, demolition of all onsite structures, and construction of 12 detached dwelling units (11 market rate residential units and one affordable, very low-income unit) in a condominium form of legal ownership utilizing State Density Bonus Law (SDBL); associated site and road improvements, and a temporary construction trailer. CASE NUMBER: APPEAL-004017-2020 and MULTI-002569-2018, BADJ-003989-2020, SUB-002571-2020, DR-002572-2018, and CDPNF-002573-2018 (18-220 TMDB/DR/CDP); APPLICANT: Yim Chun B. and Gloria Family Trust; APPELLANT: David Haist; LOCATION: 555 North Vulcan Avenue (APN 256-090-07) and 571 North Vulcan Avenue (APN 256-090-06). Contact Person: Associate Planner Dichoso
Deny the appeal, but modify the decision of the Planning Commission, and adopt the attached draft City Council Resolution No. 2020-85 (Attachment CC-1 of the agenda report), to approve the project as modified.

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON NOVEMBER 18, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
